WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND (1 + 2)
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
),
bad_customers AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
) ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
JOIN store_customers sc ON c.c_customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
LEFT JOIN bad_customers bc ON c.c_customer_sk = bc.customer_sk
WHERE bc.customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
